company.shortDescription: Weave develops an AI-powered patient communications, engagement, and payments platform for small and medium-sized healthcare practices.
company.description: Weave develops an AI-powered patient communications, engagement, and payments platform for small and medium-sized healthcare practices. The platform integrates voice, text, email, online scheduling, appointment reminders, digital forms, review management, analytics, and payment processing into a unified system. Its AI capabilities include an AI receptionist, automated text conversations, call intelligence, response assistance, and workflow automation to help practices manage patient interactions and administrative tasks. Weave also provides payment tools such as Text to Pay, online bill pay, payment plans, card-on-file payments, and payment terminals. The company serves healthcare practices across specialties, including dental, medical, veterinary, and other outpatient care providers.
